input.note: Dreamcast pad. '+' = pressed together (within the chord window); '-' = pressed in sequence (within the sequence window). Moves are ids in out/moves/moves.json. Longer sequences take priority over their endings; chords over single buttons. A sequence step can be a chord (B-X+A: B, then X and A together). In a two-step sequence that starts with a direction or a hold button (Up-A, Down-Y, B-X+A), holding that button counts the same as tapping it. 'held' lists chord buttons that may already be held down; a 'loose' chord also takes its buttons one after another, in any order, within the sequence window.
